descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.call_and_wait
descriptors.description: Call a deployed contract instance and poll exact global pipeline status until state-resolved Applied; state-resolved Rejected and Expired fail. Status polling decodes only exact HTTP 200 payloads, treats only HTTP 404 as pending, and rejects every other HTTP status. The Applied result has exactly status, hash, terminal_kind, attempts, elapsed_ms, optional submit, and final.

body.description: Exact contract-call request payload. Wait controls are never forwarded into this body.

hash.description: Optional exact canonical Iroha transaction hash override.

status_accept.description: Optional Accept header for status polling calls (defaults to application/json).

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.onboard.prepare
descriptors.description: Revalidate a signed onboarding receipt and return an authenticated exact transaction envelope without submitting it. The onboarding token is accepted only from the outer MCP request.

execution_expires_at_unix_ms.description: Positive absolute deadline; onboarding cannot outlive its signed receipt.

semantic_hash_hex.description: Hash of the exact signed onboarding receipt or solved faucet claim.

request_id.description: Caller-owned 64-hex operation identity, persisted across retries; not a server deduplication guarantee.

headers.description: Non-authentication headers only; the onboarding token must be sent on the outer MCP request.

semantic_hash_hex.description: Hash of the exact signed onboarding receipt or solved faucet claim.

request_id.description: Caller-owned 64-hex operation identity, persisted across retries; not a server deduplication guarantee.

headers.description: Non-authentication headers only; the onboarding token must be sent on the outer MCP request.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.transactions
descriptors.description: List committed transactions that canonical `path.account_id` signed or that reference it (`GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}/transactions`), newest first. Fields: `entrypoint_hash`, `block_hash`, `authority`, `entrypoint_kind`, `block_height`, `block_index`, `timestamp_ms`, `result_ok`, `asset_ids`, `asset_definition_ids` and `metadata.<key>`; `block_height` bounds in the filter's top-level `and` also bound the scan. Example: {"path": {"account_id": "sorau…"}, "filter": "block_height >= 1200 and result_ok = true", "limit": 20}. The order is fixed (no `sort`, `include_total` or `aggregate`), and a page may hold fewer than `limit` rows, even none, while `next_cursor` is set: keep passing `next_cursor` as `cursor` until it is null.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.history

Fields: id, source, type, status, result_ok, direction, account_id, counterparty_account_id, asset_id, asset_definition_id, amount, tx_hash, timestamp_ms, block_height, block_index, movement_index, operation_id, expires_at_ms, finalized_at_ms, requesting_fi_id. Use filter, select, limit, cursor; sort, include_total, aggregate are rejected. Example: {"path":{"account_id":"<I105 account id>"},"filter":"direction = 'incoming'"}. Page: {items, next_cursor}; pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` until null, even after empty pages.

descriptors.description: List a bounded seek page of explorer RWA lots with optional flat filters. Reuse next_cursor only with the exact same filters.

descriptors.name: iroha.rwas.get
descriptors.description: Fetch explorer RWA detail by canonical `path.rwa_id`.

descriptors.name: iroha.rwas.query
descriptors.description: Query RWA lots (`POST /v1/rwas/query`) with the same controls as `iroha.rwas.chain.list`, `aggregate` for grouped metrics, or one complete query in `body`. Fields: `id`, `owned_by`, `primary_reference`, `status`, `quantity` (sortable), `is_frozen` and `metadata.<key>`. Example: {"aggregate": {"group_by": ["status"], "metrics": [{"alias": "lots", "fn": "count"}, {"alias": "total", "fn": "sum", "field": "quantity"}]}}. Each page is {items, next_cursor}: pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` until it is null.

descriptors.name: iroha.transactions.wait
descriptors.description: Poll exact global pipeline status for an existing transaction hash until state-resolved Applied; state-resolved Rejected and Expired fail. Status polling decodes only exact HTTP 200 payloads, treats only HTTP 404 as pending, and rejects every other HTTP status. The Applied result has exactly status, hash, terminal_kind, attempts, elapsed_ms, and final.

status_accept.description: Optional Accept header for status polling calls (defaults to application/json).

descriptors.name: iroha.transactions.status
descriptors.description: Get the latest typed pipeline status for canonical `query.hash`. Defaults to JSON; set accept=application/x-norito for typed Norito.
